entities.name: Crop
entities.description: Social units of up to twenty people on Amonkhet who undergo the Trials of the Five Gods together.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City where people were assigned their crop at age five.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God who administers the final trial.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon whose Dreadhorde was also organized in crops.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: Crop of Samut and Djeru which Gideon temporarily joined.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who temporarily joined the Tah crop.

events.summary: At the Ceremony of Measurement the worthy are regrouped into new crops and the unworthy are culled on the Day of Harvesting.
events.quote: Those found worthy were reassembled into a new crop

events.summary: Only one member of a crop can pass the final trial and be rewarded with the afterlife.
events.quote: only one member of a crop could prove worthy

events.summary: Bolas's crop-organized Dreadhorde is defeated along with Bolas.
events.quote: These crops were defeated along with Nicol Bolas

relations.note: temporarily, for the Trial of Ambition
relations.quote: which Gideon temporarily joined for the Trial of Ambition
